title: Sanger Sequencing
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8tfrwn
materials: Set up PCR on ice, add reagents in desired order (however it is best to add the polymerase and gDNA last).

steps.title: Verify PCR Product Presence
steps.instruction: Run 15 µL of each sample on a 2% gel to determine the presence of PCR product.

substeps.instruction: Run the product on the gel at 150 V for 01:30:00

steps.title: Submit Samples for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Once the presence of PCR product is confirmed, send out a Forward and a Reverse sequence for each sample.
